rationale: This mutation eliminates the -$9,500 cash deficit by extending land expansion to Day 18 and raising plot capacity to 32-36 plots (~3.0 plots/hand), amortizing 3-4 recurring Strawberry flushes on late acreage while keeping 11 hands fully productive. It abolishes the capital-starving Day 3 flash switch by reinstating a 2-cycle Carrot liquidity engine through Day 4-5 ($1,500+ capital), reclaims lucrative 2.0x-3.5x Town Shop margins via 4-6 dedicated flexible contract plots, and replaces the Day 22 seed freeze with a Day 23-27 rapid Carrot cash-out alongside decoupled harvest/watering micro-dispatch.
